meta.title: Open AI / Agentic Security Tools Catalog
meta.description: Open, maintainable catalog of AI, LLM, agentic, and MCP security tools with OWASP Agentic Applications mapping and scoring.

dimensions.red_team: Red teaming and adversarial evaluation depth
dimensions.runtime: Runtime enforcement, prevention or inline policy control
dimensions.data_security: PII, secrets, RAG/vector store and sensitive-data controls
dimensions.observability: Tracing, monitoring, evaluation and dashboard fit
dimensions.compliance: Evidence, governance, reporting and standard mapping
dimensions.enterprise: Enterprise readiness: RBAC, deployment, auditability, support
dimensions.self_host: Ability to run without sending data to a SaaS provider
dimensions.ease: Ease of adoption for an engineering team
dimensions.agentic_readiness: Composite readiness for autonomous agent workflows: goal integrity, tool security, identity, memory, runtime, audit, and multi-agent controls
dimensions.mcp_security: MCP server/client security coverage: inventory, third-party server risk, tool permissions, authn/authz, sanitization, audit, sandboxing, supply chain

agentic_score_dimensions.goal_integrity: Detects or constrains goal drift, prompt/tool-output goal hijack, and instruction override in multi-step workflows
agentic_score_dimensions.tool_security: Validates tool calls, function parameters, dangerous actions, and tool-output trust boundaries
agentic_score_dimensions.identity_control: Supports least privilege, delegated identity, scoped credentials, RBAC/ABAC, and approval boundaries
agentic_score_dimensions.memory_security: Protects memory, RAG context, vector stores, and long-lived state from poisoning or leakage
agentic_score_dimensions.runtime_enforcement: Can block, redact, route, rate-limit, approve, or terminate risky actions at runtime
agentic_score_dimensions.auditability: Provides traces, evidence, replayable sessions, policy decisions, and governance records
agentic_score_dimensions.multi_agent_coverage: Covers agent-to-agent handoff, delegation, inter-agent communication, and cascading workflow risk
agentic_score_dimensions.mcp_security: Covers MCP clients/servers/tools, third-party server risk, permissioning, and MCP supply-chain controls

mcp_score_dimensions.server_inventory: Discovers and inventories MCP servers, clients, tools, prompts, and exposed capabilities
mcp_score_dimensions.third_party_server_risk: Assesses external or third-party MCP server trust, provenance, and data exposure risk
mcp_score_dimensions.tool_permissioning: Constrains tool scope, parameters, actions, and approval policy at the MCP/tool boundary
mcp_score_dimensions.authn_authz: Supports authentication, authorization, scoped credentials, user-to-agent delegation, and least privilege
mcp_score_dimensions.input_output_sanitization: Scans MCP inputs, tool outputs, resources, and prompts for injection or sensitive data
mcp_score_dimensions.audit_trace: Produces policy decision logs, tool-call traces, and correlation metadata for investigations
mcp_score_dimensions.sandboxing: Isolates untrusted tools, code execution, file access, network access, or server-side actions
mcp_score_dimensions.supply_chain: Detects dependency, plugin, server package, repository, and provenance risks around MCP components

tools.name: garak
tools.description: LLM vulnerability scanner using static, dynamic and adaptive probes for jailbreak, prompt injection, leakage and unsafe behavior testing.
tools.maintainer_notes: Good baseline for offline model/app red teaming; not a production runtime guardrail.

tools.name: PyRIT
tools.description: Python Risk Identification Tool for generative AI red teaming with multi-turn orchestration, converters and scoring pipelines.
tools.maintainer_notes: Strong for repeatable attack workflows and Azure-centric evaluation.

tools.name: promptfoo
tools.description: Developer-first LLM testing and red teaming framework with assertions, model comparisons, datasets, plugins and CI/CD workflows.
tools.maintainer_notes: Best fit for regression testing, CI quality gates and application-specific red-team suites.

tools.name: LLM Guard
tools.description: Input/output scanners for prompt injection, toxicity, secrets, PII, anonymization and output risk control.
tools.maintainer_notes: Practical self-hosted scanner suite; pair with orchestration/policy layer for enterprise governance.

tools.name: NeMo Guardrails
tools.description: Programmable guardrails for LLM applications using Colang rails, dialog flows and policy constraints.
tools.maintainer_notes: Good for programmable conversation policy; less complete as standalone scanner catalog.

tools.name: Guardrails AI
tools.description: Validation framework for structured outputs, schema enforcement, PII checks, toxicity and response quality validation.
tools.maintainer_notes: Strong for schema/business-rule validation; use with input scanners for full guardrail coverage.

tools.name: LlamaFirewall / PurpleLlama
tools.description: Meta PurpleLlama safety components for prompt injection, agent alignment checks and insecure-code detection.
tools.maintainer_notes: Useful for agent/tool-call safety research; verify module status before production adoption.

tools.name: Microsoft Presidio
tools.description: PII detection, anonymization and de-identification framework for text and images with customizable recognizers.
tools.maintainer_notes: Core component for PII redaction, not AI-specific agent security by itself.

tools.name: Adversarial Robustness Toolbox
tools.description: Library for adversarial attacks and defenses including evasion, poisoning, extraction and inference attacks.
tools.maintainer_notes: Classical adversarial ML focus; useful for ML security labs rather than LLM app runtime guardrails.

tools.name: Phoenix
tools.description: Open-source tracing and observability for LLM apps, embeddings, RAG and agents, with evaluation workflows.
tools.maintainer_notes: Good observability backbone; combine with scanners for enforcement.

tools.name: DeepTeam
tools.description: Red teaming framework for LLM systems with adversarial attacks, vulnerability mapping and safety metrics.
tools.maintainer_notes: Developer-friendly red teaming; validate coverage and licensing for enterprise use.

tools.name: Azure AI Content Safety / Prompt Shields
tools.description: Managed content safety APIs and prompt shield features for detecting harmful content, jailbreaks and protected material risks.
tools.maintainer_notes: Best for Azure-native stacks; limited portability/self-hosting.

tools.name: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
tools.description: Managed guardrails for Bedrock applications with topic denial, content filters, sensitive information filters and grounding checks.
tools.maintainer_notes: Strong for Bedrock-native apps; less relevant outside AWS runtime.

tools.name: Google Cloud Model Armor
tools.description: Security layer for prompt and response inspection, including prompt injection, jailbreak and malicious content filtering for Google Cloud AI workloads.
tools.maintainer_notes: Useful for Vertex/Gemini deployments; validate regional availability.

tools.name: Prisma AIRS
tools.description: Enterprise AI security platform for AI app discovery, posture management, runtime protection and model/supply-chain security.
tools.maintainer_notes: Enterprise suite candidate; confirm API, deployment and agent-framework depth during POC.

tools.name: Wiz AI-SPM
tools.description: AI Security Posture Management integrated with cloud risk graph for discovering AI services, permissions, data exposure and misconfigurations.
tools.maintainer_notes: Posture/discovery-first; not primarily a prompt guardrail.

tools.name: Cisco AI Defense
tools.description: Cisco AI security platform combining discovery, validation, access control and runtime protection for enterprise AI applications.
tools.maintainer_notes: Good enterprise review candidate; DefenseClaw is useful for architecture learning and experimentation.

tools.name: Lakera Guard
tools.description: Hosted protection API for prompt injection, jailbreak, PII and unsafe content detection with simple API integration.
tools.maintainer_notes: Fast API integration; assess data residency and enterprise logging requirements.

tools.name: HiddenLayer AISec Platform
tools.description: Enterprise AI security platform for model scanning, AI-BOM, threat detection, adversarial testing and runtime monitoring.
tools.maintainer_notes: Model-security oriented; validate LLM app and agent runtime controls for your use case.

tools.name: Mindgard
tools.description: Automated AI red teaming and risk assessment platform with attack libraries, reporting and CI/CD integration.
tools.maintainer_notes: Good vendor for red-team automation comparison; request transparent attack taxonomy and reproducibility.

tools.name: Noma Security
tools.description: AI-SPM platform focused on AI agents, MCP servers, tool inventories, agent risk scoring and policy enforcement.
tools.maintainer_notes: Agent inventory and MCP security should be validated in POC with real frameworks.

tools.name: CalypsoAI / F5 AI Security
tools.description: Enterprise AI guardrails platform for prompt scanning, policy enforcement, data protection and AI security observability.
tools.maintainer_notes: Strong candidate for gateway/runtime guardrails; assess metadata correlation, HA, streaming and on-prem requirements.

tools.name: Lasso Security
tools.description: Enterprise AI security for shadow AI discovery, access controls, sensitive-data protection and policy enforcement.
tools.maintainer_notes: Data/control governance oriented; compare with AI-SPM and CASB/SASE controls.

tools.name: Fiddler AI
tools.description: AI observability platform for monitoring, explainability, drift, bias, LLM quality and production guardrail signals.
tools.maintainer_notes: Strong monitoring/governance fit, not a primary offensive red-team tool.

tools.name: Galileo
tools.description: LLM evaluation and observability platform for hallucination, factuality, prompt quality, agent traces and production monitoring.
tools.maintainer_notes: Useful for product quality and evaluation loops; pair with security-specific scanners.

tools.name: Securiti AI Security & Governance
tools.description: AI data governance platform for sensitive-data discovery, AI data controls, RAG/vector-store scanning and compliance workflows.
tools.maintainer_notes: Best for data governance and privacy-heavy AI programs.

tools.name: Agentic Radar
tools.description: Static security scanner for agentic applications, MCP servers and tool chains across common agent frameworks.
tools.maintainer_notes: Good fit for MCP/agent supply-chain inventory; verify active repo URL and rule coverage.
